fixed_step_query_condition: A fixed query arm reads the private target exactly once at global zero-based step 3, 5 or 6 only IF still alive and no earlier refusal, otherwise a planned query is not performed; every source trial remains in the denominator.
adaptive_query_condition: Original frozen robust commanded-pose target residual tolerance 0.05m / 0.05 rad, query once only upon first robust command authorization rejection, may query after step 3.
policy_frame: Panda achieved-relative source -> accumulated-target-relative destination, exactly unchanged
original_source_method_modifications: record all original official success/readback/fault/seed events
primary_endpoints: Complete official task successes across all 32 trial seeds for all eight arms
EXACT count and timing of privileged target reads per arm
adaptive-only vs fixed-3/5/6-only actual native PhysX successes
any adaptive-late-only successes when all fixed single-read timing arms fail
certified bounded commanded-target rather than physical safety
early refusal / not-reached query counted explicitly
per-task paired discordance and full original rows
secondary_limits: A fixed scheduled query may be unable to run after an earlier refusal; report actual spent reads, do not imply equal realized budgets
All fixed arms see the same prior observed data, but controller trajectories can diverge; these are NOT offline potential-outcome splices
Interpret 32 resets and 2 checkpoints only; no real robot, no arbitrary VLA transfer, no hardware collision guarantee
No post outcome tuning; negative results retained
Exploratory paired p-values cannot be sold as confirmatory significance
